description: A tranquil English garden terrace captured at golden hour with soft sunset light washing over the scene from the right horizon. The terrace floor is large-format natural limestone or travertine pavers in a warm cream and tan tone. Two oversized low-profile poufy lounge chairs in light grey linen fabric face each other across a small rustic stone coffee table with a chunky rectilinear pedestal base. Between the chairs, a tall candlestick-style floor piece in dark bronze-toned metal holds a glowing frosted globe that emits a warm diffused light, pooling gently on the stone pavers below. The background garden features a lush border of billowing white hydrangea shrubs and tall lavender in purple bloom, creating a soft cottage garden texture. A dark charcoal-painted wood garden shed with a pitched roof sits in the left background. Dense mature trees form a dark green canopy above, with the warm peach-gold of the setting sun glowing through the foliage on the right side. A stone urn planter sits at the terrace edge on the right. The corner of a large market umbrella in natural canvas is visible at the upper left. The whole scene is suffused with a warm golden amber glow from the setting sun, with shadows stretching long and soft across the pavers. Camera at standing eye-level, wide establishing shot, slightly off-center composition showing the full seating vignette against the garden backdrop. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
